# Dr. Firdous Shaikh

Dr. Firdous Shaikh is a diabetologist, thyroid and weight-management physician in Mumbai. Her practice covers diabetes, thyroid conditions, obesity and metabolic health, women's health, and diabetes wellbeing.

Clinics: Jyoti Clinic, Hill-N-Dale Building, 3rd Floor, Hill Road, Near Bandra Police Station, Above Abhudhaya Bank, Bandra (West), Mumbai 400050; Monday/Wednesday/Friday 6pm to 9pm. Niramay Diabetes Centre, Evershine Maternity and Nursing Home, A/ Sundaram, Dharti Building, 002, Bharti Nagar, Mira Road East, Mira Bhayandar, Maharashtra 401107; Tuesday/Saturday 10am to 5pm.

Appointments: +91 99305 61774. Email: drfirdousshaikh@gmail.com.
